Vendor Overview: CaseBlink is an AI software designed specifically for immigration law firms, aiming to streamline the preparation of immigration cases.
Product Description: CaseBlink offers end-to-end AI automation for immigration cases, allowing users to organize evidence, prepare exhibit lists, draft customizable letters, and compile exhibits into a ready-to-file packet. The platform is user-friendly and designed to enhance the efficiency of immigration case preparation.
Main problem solved: Streamlining the preparation and organization of immigration cases to save time and reduce errors.
AI Platform Type: Document understanding, legal research, tailored drafting
